channel.description: Updates of PvZ2 Reflourished for the Mac (Reflourished-Darwin)

item.title: Reflourished-Darwin 1.5.5 · PvZ2: Reflourished 1.5.0
item.description:
Reflourished 1.5.5. The carnival hats, two crashes and a choppy seed picker.

  • The hats in the Caliginous Carnival take a tap or click again; before, they mostly ignored it.
  • Windows: fixed the game closing by itself during some levels, most often after Retry on the loss screen (Holiday Mashup Day 3 was one).
  • Mac and Windows: fixed a crash when you pressed a seed's key again to put it back and clicked the lawn at the same moment.
  • Mac and Windows: a gaming mouse that reports its position very often no longer floods the game with movements, which could make the Select your Seeds screen choppy on some PCs.
